policy.display: Preserve every entry inside its original historical parent. Substitute only exact visible prefixes at the four identified cells, with an adjacent missing-text label and physical-page link. Preserve complete embedded text separately in reviewer evidence; never quote hidden suffixes as visible publisher text.
policy.amounts: INFO historical context; no amount or new allegation from these rows. Preserve the following court-award finding, all other findings, clean statements and opinions.
policy.binding: Bind an implementation to the exact PDF digest, parent/vote/fiscal year, marked cell, complete parent inventory and render identities. Unknown, different, missing or tampered qualifications refuse.
policy.admission: No generic review flag or reconciliation approval bypass. Existing common L3 and direct loader holds remain unchanged. Separately reviewed code, exact representation approval, national authority and a current-row adoption packet are still required.
policy.rollout: Review exact API/page/export/search/accessibility text and source links before public loading. No implementation or publishing is included.
policy.rollback: Remove the exact representation and withhold affected parents. Adopted data also requires complete extraction/audit before-images and a reviewed transaction rollback; code revert is insufficient.
